resources.string: Switch to another app and Zlip shrinks to a small window, so the cover stays on; turn the cover on and off from there.
If neither screen is touched for this long while Zlip is open, the cover turns off. A notice comes 15 seconds before; one touch keeps it on.
Shows your screen on the cover. Android asks for permission every time.
Your screen is on the cover until you leave Zlip. Protected apps such as banking or Netflix show black, and mirroring uses more battery.
Your screen is on the cover, in other apps too while Zlip is the Mini cover. Protected apps such as banking or Netflix show black, and mirroring uses more battery.
Mirroring could not start. Try again.
Whole screen shows all of it with black bars; Fill fills the cover and crops the edges.
On the cover: double-tap, then tap to switch and swipe to see the cropped part.
Protected apps show black, Android asks for permission every time, and mirroring uses more battery.
Shown while your screen is mirrored to the cover, with a button to stop.
Mirroring your screen to the cover
The picture never leaves your phone and is not recorded.
